items.q: How long does interior cleaning take?
items.a: Without disassembly — 1 day depending on condition. With disassembly — up to 2 days including full drying.

items.q: Do I need to book in advance?
items.a: Yes, usually 1–2 days ahead. Call us and we'll find a convenient slot. You can also fill in the form and we'll call you back ourselves.

items.q: What does the price depend on?
items.a: On the car's configuration and condition. We give the exact price after an initial inspection at the studio — it's fixed before work starts and never changes.

items.q: How long does ceramic coating last?
items.a: With proper care, a ceramic coating can last around 2 years or more. Once the service is complete, we provide recommendations on aftercare and help you choose the right chemistry for maintaining your car after the ceramic coating is applied.

items.q: What percentage of scratches does polishing remove?
items.a: 1-step — up to 50%, 3-step — up to 80%, deep rotary polishing — 90% and more. We'll be able to give an exact estimate after inspecting the paintwork.

items.q: Can I leave the car for the whole day?
items.a: Yes, we can arrange drop-off and pick-up at a time that suits you. Our studio is open Monday to Saturday, 09:00–18:00.
